reviews.text:
Dr. Darden and the staff at this facility are awesome.
Very friendly and helpful administrative staff and assistants.

Our 13 year old fur baby first visited STV after we noticed he was presenting as blind. He was diagnosed and  treated for  a detached retina in both eyes. After @ 3 months of care, the retinas have laid down and it appears he has regain limited vision in both eyes.

Dr. Darden and assistants have been awesome. DR Darden cared for our little fur baby as if he was his own.  Definitely recommend.

Many thanks to Dr. Darden and staff at STV.
Scary to go to, but experts in their field make you feel at ease. Took great care of son’s dog yesterday.

Dr. Esterline repaired my girl’s fracture, and then her luxating  patella, now Cayenne Mahogany Roux is BETTER THAN EVER!!!  I wish I could share video of her running all over the backyard!  Thank you for taking such great care of my “chicken nugget” ❤️

Hi Mr. Sholley - thanks for taking the time to leave us a review, but without any feedback it makes it harder for us to understand the needs of our clients. Please give us a call when you have a moment and let us know how we can earn 5 stars next time.

Took really good care of our Senior Boxer, and provided us all the facts and options for us to make an educated decision on how best to take care of her and provide her quality of life.

She is doing much better and the treatments are having a positive reaction shrinking her tumors. We keep praying for her and loving on her.  She is acting like her old self even though she is sick thanks to them!

Dr Esterline and her entire staff were incredibly supportive and knowledgeable! They answered all the millions of questions and concerns I had with my pup. Their communication was excellent through the entire process. We did a TECA (total ear canal ablation) and from the very first consultation to the end of recovery this staff was on it! I HIGHLY recommend SAVS to everyone needed further treatment with their fur babies.

This hospital is amazing. Max had an eye ulcer. It was terrifying. Thank goodness our vet Dr. Jeff sent us here to specialists!!
Dr Fritz took care to graph Max’s eye.
Many eye drops, cones, and many worried phone calls later, now, Max is happy and healthy.
These assistants are caring and remember us each visit. A real life saver of a hospital .
Thank you 🐕❤️
Staff is amazing  and super friendly
Staff is caring, kind and helpful.  The vets and vet techs are awesome. Highly recommend
Very professional Dr Fitch and everyone was super nice. I would recommend this office to anyone needing expert help.

Love Dr. Esterline and staff! Sooo much that I’ve brought 3 of my fur babies to this specialty clinic this year alone! As an LVT, I highly recommend their skilled expertise and professionalism! Congrats on becoming an AAHA-accredited hospital SO quickly too! It’s extremely difficult to find these gems! Thank you!!
The oncologists are top notch and have been a great help with my cat.  The staff is friendly and knowledgeable.

I cannot thank this veterinarian clinic enough for their exceptional care and attention. After my dog was poorly treated at another clinic, we were desperate for help. The team here jumped in immediately, providing the urgent care my dog needed. Their professionalism, compassion, and dedication were evident from the moment we walked in. They not only treated my dog with the utmost care but also took the time to explain every step of the process to us, ensuring we felt comfortable and informed. I am incredibly grateful for the amazing service they provided and highly recommend their services to everyone. Bélico is happy and thriving thanks to their entire team.

These people are great. Our little girl had to have her spleen removed. Pet owner, family friendly,reasonably priced, to save our little girl. Checked up on her with text messages when she had to stay overnight. The Dr explained everything, we felt at ease after talking to the surgeon. Thanks to all that work there.
They took exceptional care of my dog with the highest level of detail. We received picture updates as well as regular text updates

We were referred here for a procedure and couldn't be happier with the outcome for our guy. The communication from the staff throughout the entire surgery and recovery was more than I expected. They even sent a picture of our sweet pup after his surgery. It was so comforting to have that communication during this time! The bandana he was sent home in was a nice touch as well. The staff was very thorough in explaining to us what his recovery would look like and never made me feel rushed. Kudos to the entire staff!
